delivery.title: Install the Apex CLI at the pinned upstream commit
delivery.command: git clone https://github.com/macrocosm-os/apex.git apex && git -C apex checkout da4a308ea7e097a1e357937e5a322a54bba9cc41 && (cd apex && ./install_cli.sh) && apex --help
delivery.note: install_cli.sh installs uv, runs `uv sync` against the upstream uv.lock (bittensor==10.4.0 etc.) and `uv tool install src/cli`. Do it outside this repository. If `apex` is not found, add ~/.local/bin to PATH.

delivery.title: Install the scorer dependencies pinned to the evaluator image
delivery.note: numpy==2.4.6 and scipy==1.17.1, copied from the upstream energy_arbitrage Dockerfile requirements (python:3.12-slim).

delivery.title: Link the miner's registered netuid-1 hotkey to the Apex CLI
delivery.note: Writes .apex.config.json ({"hotkey_file_path": ..., "timeout": 60.0}) in the working directory; it signs and pays nothing. The hotkey must already be registered on netuid 1, or the orchestrator answers 403. Never commit .apex.config.json.

delivery.title: Resolve the energy_arbitrage competition id and fee
delivery.note: Requests are signed with the linked hotkey (Epistula) and sent to apex.api.macrocosmos.ai. Confirm that the competition is active, still takes a Python policy(view, state) file and shows its submission fee. Then set APEX_COMPETITION_ID.

delivery.title: Check, evaluate and package the candidate
delivery.command: python3 tracks/main/miner.py check && python3 tracks/main/miner.py evaluate && python3 tracks/main/miner.py run
delivery.note: run copies solution.py to tracks/main/dist/ with its sha256 and prints the exact submit command. Compare the local score with the leaderboard top (`apex list -c $APEX_COMPETITION_ID -t`) before asking for a submission.

delivery.title: Approve the submission fee and submit the packaged solution
delivery.note: The CLI transfers the per-competition fee in TAO from the coldkey to SUBMISSION_FEE_ADDRESS and asks for the coldkey password. It then uploads the file, signed with the hotkey. Rewards are winner-takes-all, so the fee is lost unless this beats the current leader. If payment succeeds but the upload fails, retry with --payment-block-hash/--payment-extrinsic-index instead of paying again.

delivery.title: Track the submission score against the leaderboard
delivery.command: apex list -c $APEX_COMPETITION_ID -m && apex list -c $APEX_COMPETITION_ID -t && apex result <submission_id>
delivery.note: Read-only. Record the gap between the live score and the local evaluate score. Weights follow the orchestrator's global scores (validators set weights every 1260 s).

settings.name: EA_SEED
settings.description: Master seed for local evaluate (instance seeds derive from it as in upstream test_challenge.py). Live seeds are hidden.

settings.name: EA_NUM_INSTANCES
settings.description: Instances scored by local evaluate; scenarios cycle BASELINE, CONGESTED, MULTIDAY, DENSE, CAPSTONE.

settings.name: EA_SANDBOX
settings.description: Run the candidate in the upstream subprocess sandbox during evaluate (true matches the live evaluator).
